title: game/recipes.json
description: The crafting recipes. Every name is the id of a catalogue noun of game/nouns.json. Loaded by RecipeBook (Vocaterra.Game.Core).

output.description: The noun made; it must name an item. One recipe per output.

makes.description: The item the recipe makes, by its key, when the output noun names several items (apple names the apple and the roast apple); it must be one of the noun's items. Default: the noun's first item.

item.description: A catalogue noun id that names an item.

station.description: A catalogue noun id that names a block the player stands at to craft (table).
